name: Capture Anime!
desc:
⚓ Welcome to Capture Anime! 🔥
Capture and Train powerful Anime Characters, grow powerful teams, and take on tougher enemies as you progress the game. ❄️


🎁 Capture Rare Anime Heroes to build a Strong Team
😈 Defeat bosses to Unlock New Areas
🚀 Upgrade and Train Your Team
🛡️Collect the Ultimate Team
🏆 Climb the Leaderboards


👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
